context: Hi!
Hello how are you doing?
I'm good! How are you?
I'm great. I'm looking for some movie recommendations. My favorite kind of movies, is mostly drama but I also like comedy as well.
What is the last movie that you watched?
The last movie I watched was A Dog's Journey and I absolutely loved it. It was such a fantastic and heartwarming movie.
Perfect! So do you want a movie with a similar story or a different one?
I would love to find a movie with somewhat of a similar story, it was just so good, I would be very interested in watching something simliar.
I recommend you to watch The Art of Racing in the Rain
Cool can you tell me a little bit about ti?

Denny Swift is a Formula One race car driver who understands that the techniques needed on the racetrack can also be used to successfully navigate everyday life. Besides his career, Denny has three loves of his life -- his beautiful wife, their young daughter and his best friend, which is a dog that wants to be reincarnated into a human.
That sounds amazing. I will absolutely check that out. I've never heard of it before but it sounds exactly like something I would enjoy.Thank you very much for the recommendation.
You're very welcome! I'm happy to help
What sort of movies do you most enjoy?
Romantic and Drama
Whats your favorite romance movie? I really like how to loose a guy in 10 days
The notebook and Me before you
The notebook is such a great movie.
Have you watched The Wedding Planner?
I have, I always really liked that movie as well.
I'm glad to hear that! I hope you'll enjoy the movie
